text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The G2 Kinko Sho is upon us, and
Silence Suzuka
is the calmest she's ever
been.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Winning this race is my ticket to
competing in
even faster ones.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I can hardly contain my excitement.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
All I can think about is how far I'll be
able to go in
this race today.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I have a feeling I'm going to see
something
special this time.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
choice_data_list: めいっぱい楽しんでおいで！
choice_data_list_en: Go have the time of your life!
